ui_adm_confirm_reset: Reset %s to default? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_fire_all: Fire every member of staff at %s (the owner is kept)?

ui_adm_confirm_delete_animal: Delete animal #%s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_empty: Empty every item out of %s? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_delete_storage: Delete %s and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
ui_adm_confirm_reset_settings: Reset %s back to its config values?
